parameters.description: The parameter is deprecated! This is applicable to native query only. True if to default search on legacy fields which splits on whitespace, lower-case and prefix match.

parameters.description: Search query to match objects. Return order undefined. [Lucene Query Syntax](https://lucene.apache.org/core/2_9_4/queryparsersyntax.html)

parameters.name: qf
parameters.description: The qf parameter specifies the fields in the index on which to perform the query. The parameter should only reference the index attributes having index="true" in the view model. Searching on non-indexed attributes will returns no hits.

parameters.name: relatedId
parameters.description: Results can be joined to objects that are related to the given id(s)

parameters.name: rootTo
parameters.description: Results can be joined to either their root resource or data set

parameters.name: shards
parameters.description: Advanced option. List of search shards to query. By default all shards are queried.

parameters.name: sliderFacetJson
parameters.description: If faceting is enabled, user can specify slider facet in JSON format to create on the fly facet.

parameters.name: sort

get.description: Use this API to fetch events of all types. The application/json-len format is a special binary format where each event is converted into a JSON string.
